title: The Badge in the Ditch
lines: Ben got a little badge for his best catch.
He pins it on his black vest.
On the path, the pin slips off.
The badge drops into a thick, wet ditch.
Ben digs in the mud but finds a rock.
He digs and digs. No badge at all.
Then Meg hands him a long stick.
Ben pokes at the edge of the ditch.
The stick taps the badge in the thick mud.
He tugs it up and rubs the mud off.
Meg pins the little badge back on his vest.

questions.ask: How did Ben lose the badge?
questions.listenFor: The pin slipped off on the path and the badge dropped into the ditch. Two steps - let them find both.

questions.ask: What did Ben use to find the badge in the mud?
questions.listenFor: The long stick Meg handed him. If they say "he dug for it," ask "did digging work?"

questions.ask: What was Ben's problem in this story? Who helped him solve it?
questions.listenFor: The badge dropped in the ditch, and Meg handed him a long stick. Lines four and seven.
